LESSON: LANGUAGE USE 10.3.1 PREPOSITIONS

Grade: SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade two
Subject: ENGLISH LANGUAGE ACTIVITIES
Strand: Strand 10
Topic 10.3: Language use 10.3.1 Prepositions
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Language use 10.3.1 Prepositions, part of Strand 10 in SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade two ENGLISH LANGUAGE ACTIVITIES.

Key inquiry question: Where do we keep different things in the school and at home?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. listen to an audio clip of a poem, conversation or a story and list the prepositions used.

2. read sentences with the prepositions: (beside, above, over, below, across, to, at).

3. play a miming game with peers.

4. describe the location of various objects in the classroom using suitable prepositions. Give learners with blindness spatial orientation before they can describe the location of various objects.

5. construct sentences using target prepositions and share with peers.

6. practise using target prepositions in a dialogue with peers.

7. sing short songs/rhymes with prepositions.

8. play language games containing target prepositions.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. listen to an audio clip of a poem, conversation or a story and list the prepositions used.
2. read sentences with the prepositions: (beside, above, over, below, across, to, at).
3. play a miming game with peers.
4. describe the location of various objects in the classroom using suitable prepositions. Give learners with blindness spatial orientation before they can describe the location of various objects.
5. construct sentences using target prepositions and share with peers.
6. practise using target prepositions in a dialogue with peers.
7. sing short songs/rhymes with prepositions.
8. play language games containing target prepositions.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Language use 10.3.1 Prepositions together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
Self –efficacy; enhanced as the learner uses prepositions correctly in communication.

Values:
Unity as the learner displays team spirit when singing short songs/ rhymes

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
Citizenship(social cohesion) as the learner collaborates with peers to play language games.

Links to other Learning Areas:
Repositions are also learnt in Kiswahili Language Activities (Vihusishi).
